sources.title: Government of Anguilla, Official national holidays for 2026
sources.said: New Year's Day Thursday, 1 January; James Ronald Webster Day Monday, 2 March; Good Friday Friday, 3 April; Easter Monday Monday, 6 April; Labour Day Friday, 1 May; Whit Monday Monday, 25 May; Anguilla Day Monday, 1 June; Celebration of the Birthday of His Majesty The King Monday, 22 June; August Monday Monday, 3 August; August Thursday Thursday, 6 August; Constitution Day Friday, 7 August; National Heroes and Heroines Friday, 18 December; Christmas Day Friday, 25 December; Boxing Day Monday, 28 December.
